entries.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.Boundary
entries.docstring:
A boundary of `S : (PureU1 n.succ).charges` (assumed sorted, constAbs and non-zero)
is defined as a element of `k ∈ Fin n` such that `S k.castSucc` and `S k.succ` are different signs.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
def Boundary (S : (PureU1 n.succ).Charges) (k : Fin n) : Prop

entries.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.boundary_castSucc
entries.snippet: lemma boundary_castSucc {k : Fin n} (hk : Boundary S k) : S k.castSucc = S (0 : Fin n.succ)

entries.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.boundary_succ
entries.snippet: lemma boundary_succ {k : Fin n} (hk : Boundary S k) : S k.succ = - S (0 : Fin n.succ)

entries.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.boundary_split
entries.snippet: lemma boundary_split (k : Fin n) :  k.succ.val + (n.succ - k.succ.val) = n.succ

entries.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.boundary_accGrav'
entries.snippet:
lemma boundary_accGrav' (k : Fin n) : accGrav n.succ S =
    ∑ i : Fin (k.succ.val + (n.succ - k.succ.val)), S (Fin.cast (boundary_split k) i)

entries.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.boundary_accGrav''
entries.snippet:
lemma boundary_accGrav'' (k : Fin n) (hk : Boundary S k) :
    accGrav n.succ S = (2 * ↑↑k + 1 - ↑n) * S (0 : Fin n.succ)

entries.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.HasBoundary
entries.docstring: We say a `S ∈ charges` has a boundary if there exists a `k ∈ Fin n` which is a boundary.

def HasBoundary (S : (PureU1 n.succ).Charges) : Prop

entries.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.not_hasBoundary_zero_le

lemma not_hasBoundary_zero_le (hnot : ¬ (HasBoundary S)) (h0 : S (0 : Fin n.succ) < 0) :
    ∀ i, S (0 : Fin n.succ) = S i

entries.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.not_hasBoundry_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma not_hasBoundry_zero (hnot : ¬ (HasBoundary S)) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    S (0 : Fin n.succ) = S i

entries.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.not_hasBoundary_grav
entries.snippet:
lemma not_hasBoundary_grav (hnot :  ¬ (HasBoundary S)) :
    accGrav n.succ S = n.succ * S (0 : Fin n.succ)

entries.name: PreFeynmanRule

  VertexLabel : Type

entries.name: PreFeynmanRule.DiagramVertexProp
entries.docstring:
The proposition on vertices which must be satisfied by an object
  `F : Over (P.HalfEdgeLabel × P.EdgeLabel × P.VertexLabel)` for it to be a Feynman diagram.
  This condition corresponds to the vertices of `F` having the correct half-edges associated
  with them.

The proposition on edges which must be satisfied by an object
  `F : Over (P.HalfEdgeLabel × P.EdgeLabel × P.VertexLabel)` for it to be a Feynman diagram.
  This condition corresponds to the edges of `F` having the correct half-edges associated
  with them.

    (f : 𝓔 ⟶ P.EdgeLabel)

entries.name: PreFeynmanRule.diagramVertexProp_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma diagramVertexProp_iff {𝓔 𝓥 : Type} (F : Over (P.HalfEdgeLabel × 𝓔 × 𝓥))
    (f : 𝓥 ⟶ P.VertexLabel) : P.DiagramVertexProp F f ↔
    ∀ v, ∃ (κ : (P.vertexLabelMap (f v)).left → ((P.preimageVertex v).obj F).left),
    Function.Bijective κ
    ∧ ((P.preimageVertex v).obj F).hom ∘ κ = (P.vertexLabelMap (f v)).hom

entries.name: PreFeynmanRule.diagramEdgeProp_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma diagramEdgeProp_iff {𝓔 𝓥 : Type} (F : Over (P.HalfEdgeLabel × 𝓔 × 𝓥))
    (f : 𝓔 ⟶ P.EdgeLabel) : P.DiagramEdgeProp F f ↔
    ∀ v, ∃ (κ : (P.edgeLabelMap (f v)).left → ((P.preimageEdge v).obj F).left),
    Function.Bijective κ
    ∧ ((P.preimageEdge v).obj F).hom ∘ κ = (P.edgeLabelMap (f v)).hom
